title: The Birthday Chair and a Best-Beside
youtube_title: The Birthday Chair and a Best-Beside | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship makes room before it keeps score.
summary: At a schoolyard with a low swing and a circle of stones, Kesi is just outside the fun, close to a chair beside the birthday chair. Ilaria changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Kesi has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Cousin Pio lets the children solve it.
